cardinal.atlas_order: row-major; variant 0 masks 0-15, variant 1 masks 0-15, variant 2 masks 0-15, variant 3 masks 0-15
cardinal.light_border: edge pixels of each exposed side use corresponding original cobble role; inner band 2-4 pixels with hard-cluster intermediate ramp

diagonals.atlas_order: row-major variant 0 NW,NE,SE,SW; variant 1 NW,NE,SE,SW; variant 2 NW,NE,SE,SW; variant 3 NW,NE,SE,SW
diagonals.applicability: ONLY if center is shaded, both edge-adjacent cardinal neighbors at that corner are also shaded, and diagonal neighbor is normal; multiple overlays may be applied if independent corners qualify
diagonals.overlay_mode: draw transparent RGBA overlay onto an opaque floor tile; opaque pixels replace those beneath; binary alpha only
diagonals.layer_order: 1 base normal or shaded / selected cardinal tile on FLOOR, 2 applicable diagonal overlays over same ground cell, 3 any independent environment art and actors by normal depth policy

rendering_contract.source_variant: Use 0-3 existing normal cobble variant indexes; same variant for mask and corner overlay
rendering_contract.selection_for_shaded_center: If center cobble is shaded visually, compute mask by checking N E S W normal-cobble neighbors, draw cardinal tile variant*16+mask; diagonal overlays only when its two cardinal neighbors are shaded and diagonal is normal. All other tiles draw the existing normal source variant.
rendering_contract.visual_state_source: authored ground material/daylight-vs-shade decision (coding agent maps locations), not automatic gameplay concealment
rendering_contract.gameplay_concealment: shadowZones remains the sole gameplay authority, owned by coding agent

limitations: An 8-neighbor topological state is not fully expressible by a 4-bit mask alone. Diagonal-only daylight relief is covered by inset 16 overlays, but exact mathematically continuous brightness at every pathological stair-step T-junction is not guaranteed; review authored layouts at native scale.
Only cobblestone; the previously reported ~496 shaded-ground locations may include other material classes.
This is art review, not full B.2-04 in-engine validation.
No Tempest crouch sheet was supplied; approved standing/walking and Lookout combat are tested.
